description: Energizing breath with short sharp exhales, in short rounds only. Not for beginners. Stop immediately if dizzy or lightheaded.
name: Kapalabhati (Skull-Shining Breath)

phases.instruction: Sit tall. Take 2-3 slow normal breaths. This is vigorous — stop and breathe normally if you feel dizzy.
phases.label: Prepare

phases.instruction: Short sharp exhales through the nose, belly snapping in; inhales stay passive. STOP if dizzy.
phases.label: Kapalabhati round 1 of 3

phases.instruction: Breathe normally and notice how you feel. No forcing.
phases.label: Rest

phases.instruction: Again: sharp exhales, passive inhales. STOP if dizzy.
phases.label: Kapalabhati round 2 of 3

phases.instruction: Breathe normally. Let your heartbeat settle.
phases.label: Rest

phases.instruction: Final round: sharp exhales, passive inhales. STOP if dizzy.
phases.label: Kapalabhati round 3 of 3

phases.instruction: Breathe normally for a full rest. Session complete.
phases.label: Rest
